_comment: Single source of truth for recommend_ollama_model.py and any generated docs. 'confirmed_models' means someone on this project has actually run this exact model through AutoSAM/RADIANT-LLM/AutoFLUKA's tool-calling flow and it worked -- not just 'should fit in VRAM'. Each confirmed model carries a 'confirmed_hardware' list -- one entry per machine/GPU it's been independently verified on, so the same model can accumulate multiple confirmations over time instead of only ever recording the first one. 'suggested_models' are untested guesses (same model confirmed at a nearby tier, or a well-known model) -- flag them as such to users, never claim they're verified. 'param_billions' ranks models within/across tiers so the script can recommend the biggest confirmed model your hardware can run, not just whatever happens to match your exact tier -- a model confirmed on LESS VRAM than you have is assumed to also run on yours (same or less CPU/GPU offload, same weights), so it stays eligible for recommendation. Do not duplicate a model into a higher tier's suggested_models purely to make it visible there; the script does that cross-tier lookup automatically from param_billions + the tier it was actually confirmed on.

confirmed_models.notes: Custom local build: qwen3.6:35b with context extended to 131072 tokens (128k) plus adjusted sampling params, built via the included Modelfile -- not a registry tag, `ollama pull qwen3.6:35b-128k` will fail. The plain qwen3.6:35b base (default context, directly pullable) has not been independently tested for tool-calling on its own.

confirmed_hardware.notes: Runs via Ollama's automatic CPU/GPU layer offload, not fully in VRAM. Slower than full-GPU inference but tool-calling confirmed working.

confirmed_hardware.hardware: NVIDIA RTX PRO 3000 (Blackwell) Laptop GPU, 12GB VRAM class (Windows)
confirmed_hardware.notes: Confirmed via a live SAM input execution/error-resolution session in AutoSAM: model correctly invoked file reads, background job execution, log/JSON parsing, skill consultation, and ERKB error-database search in sequence. Context window loaded correctly at 131,072 tokens.
